name: SkyCollection
dataStorage: Collection discoveries are saved with the active Skyrim save. SkyCounter UI owns item rendering and caches icons under Data/SKSE/Plugins/SkyOS/Mods/SkyCounterUI/Icons/ and location screenshots under Data/SKSE/Plugins/SkyOS/Mods/SkyCounterUI/Locations/. SkyCollection reads and displays those shared caches.
